text:
morgan: Drafting internal release note for tonight's deploy. Target change window 7:00pm PT. Need quick sign-off and pinning plan. Posting draft below, please thumbs up or comment. :ear:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for 2025-06-15 02:00 UTC. Canary enabled. Rollback window 30m. CI: ✅ all checks passed.

sana: LGTM on timing. One ask: call out the schema migration is backward compatible and doesn't need a client rollout.

morgan: Good call. I'll add a line. Also plan to pin model-serving from v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0, config flag enable_new_cache=true. Ops, can you pin 10% traffic for a 15m canary?

leo-ops: Can do. I'll create canary routing rule `canary-release-1746000000` and pin 10% for 15m, then escalate to 50% if metrics look good. Paging oncall: @nora.

nora: Oncall ack. I'll monitor error rates and latency. If errors >1% or latency P95 rises >150ms baseline -> I'll trigger rollback per playbook.

sana: Release note draft (copy below):

```
Release: model-serving v2.4.0
When: 2025-06-15 02:00 UTC (7:00pm PT)
What: Performance and caching improvements for token-serving pipeline. Includes schema migration (backwards-compatible), and new cache toggle (enable_new_cache=true).
Canary: 10% traffic for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% if stable.
Rollback: automated rollback if error rate >1% or latency regressions.
Contacts: leo-ops (SRE), nora (oncall), morgan (product)
Docs: internal RN + rollback runbook links will be posted in announcement.
```

morgan: Thanks — I'll add docs links and schedule internal announcement in ~15m (6:45pm PT) so teams have heads-up. Any objections? :rocket:

lucy: tiny nit: include direct links to the rollback runbook and RN doc, and call out the DB migration is read-only for 48h. Also add a cross-ref to the feature flag ticket.

morgan: Updated: added rollback runbook link + migration note + ticket #PLAT-4827. Pinned RN draft to docs: https://internal.redwood/rn/1746000000 (internal link). Thanks! :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary traffic 10% routed at 2025-06-15T02:15:00Z. Observability window active.

nora: Observability update after 10m: latency stable, error rate 0.2%. No action. Holding for 15m then promote.

leo-ops: Promoted to 50% at 2025-06-15T02:30:00Z. Noting a small uptick in eviction warnings, within threshold.

morgan: Promoted to 100% at 2025-06-15T02:45:00Z. Closing thread for now — will post a brief deploy note in #general and open a follow-up if anything crops up. Thanks all! :tada:
